dump_queries.tracks: SELECT track_id, track_uri, name, artists, album, duration_ms, explicit, popularity, release_date, isrc FROM tracks ORDER BY track_id
dump_queries.plays: SELECT played_at_ms, track_id, track_uri, context_type, context_uri, source FROM plays ORDER BY played_at_ms, track_id
dump_queries.track_artists: SELECT track_id, artist_id, artist_name, position FROM track_artists ORDER BY track_id, artist_id
dump_queries.artists: SELECT artist_id, name, genres, popularity, followers FROM artists ORDER BY artist_id
dump_queries.playlist_tracks: SELECT playlist_id, track_id, track_uri FROM playlist_tracks ORDER BY playlist_id, track_id
dump_queries.state: SELECT key, CASE WHEN key LIKE 'playlist_cache_refreshed_ms:%' THEN 'set' ELSE value END AS value FROM state WHERE key != 'spotify_refresh_token' ORDER BY key
dump_queries.sync_runs: SELECT cursor_in_ms, cursor_out_ms, plays_fetched, tracks_added, status, error IS NOT NULL AS has_error FROM sync_runs ORDER BY id
dump_queries.playlists: SELECT playlist_id, name, artist_name, playlist_type FROM playlists ORDER BY playlist_id
dump_queries.playlist_removals: SELECT playlist_id, track_id, track_uri FROM playlist_removals ORDER BY playlist_id, track_id
dump_queries.playlist_exclusions: SELECT artist_name, playlist_id FROM playlist_exclusions ORDER BY artist_name
